node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 cofactor-4 exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(4,2,0) cofactor 4 is impossible. Dual complete normalized streams leave 21376 vectors after the high-variance exclusion. FLINT and PARI agree through a 64-bucket multiset fingerprint, and every quotient Norm/4 lies strictly outside the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual streamed enumeration and exact arithmetic reduce the leading prize profile to the sole cofactor 2. No aggregate weighted pair count is claimed.
